description: This PHP class implements handling of data: URIs for base64 encoded images, including validation, MIME type checking, and rewriting URIs.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIScheme_data
classes.description: Class for handling data: URI schemes for base64-encoded images, extending HTMLPurifier_URIScheme.

methods.name: doValidate
methods.description: Validates and processes a data URI, decoding base64 data, checking image type, and rewriting the URI if valid.

methods.name: muteErrorHandler
methods.description: A placeholder error handler to suppress errors during image size detection.
